---
name: Documentation Issue
description: Report issues with docs, examples, or clarity improvements

## Documentation Issue
What documentation needs improvement? (e.g., missing guide, unclear concept, outdated example)

## Current State
Link to the specific doc page/section and describe what's missing or confusing.

## Proposed Change
What should be added/changed? Include why this improves clarity or adoption.

## Context
How does this relate to Verity's philosophy or common user pain points?

## Examples Needed
If requesting new examples, specify the domain/framework and key patterns to demonstrate.
